links.reported_relation: With amount0Out = totalLaunchpadFee0 and no prior token transfer, swap infers a nonzero amount-in from balances that include fees while reserves exclude them, enabling the theft.
Balances include accrued fees but reserves do not, so the contract incorrectly infers a transfer that did not occur, which the attacker exploits.
Because reserves are updated to balances minus accrued fees, the attacker can repeat swap in one transaction and drain funds from the protocol.
